result.instructions: Tools for Friendbuy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many referral shares did we get last week, and which campaign sent the most?"; "Show purchases attributed to referrals in November, with their order totals."; "What is this customer's loyalty balance in points?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Friendbuy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run friendbuy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run friendbuy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run friendbuy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. friendbuy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: friendbuy_list_shares
tools.title: List advocate shares
tools.description: List referral shares sent by advocates in a date range, optionally by campaign, advocate or channel. Friendbuy: GET /v1/analytics/shares.

from_date.description: Start of the search period, ISO 8601 timestamp (for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z).

to_date.description: End of the search period, ISO 8601 timestamp (for example 2026-01-31T23:59:59Z).

advocate_customer_id.description: Your customer id for the shopper (not a Friendbuy id).

page_token.description: nextPageToken from the previous reply, to get the next page.
